description: Unique numeric identifier for each row, useful for indexing and referencing records.
Unique text identifier for each order, used to track and group order details.
Date when the order was placed, important for time-based analyses.
Date when the order was shipped, used to calculate shipping duration.
Shipping method category, indicating delivery speed and service type.
Unique identifier for each customer, used to link orders to customers.
Name of the customer, useful for identification and reporting.
Customer segment classification, indicating market or customer type.
Country of the customer or order destination, fixed as United States.
City of the customer or shipping address, useful for geographic analysis.
State of the customer or shipping address, useful for regional analysis.
Numeric postal code for location, used for geographic grouping.
Geographic region category, grouping states into broader areas.
Unique identifier for each product, used to track product details.
High-level product category, classifying products into broad groups.
More detailed product classification within categories, for finer analysis.
Name of the product, useful for identification and reporting.
Monetary value of sales per order line, used to measure revenue.
Number of units sold per order line, indicating purchase volume.
Discount rate applied to the sale, expressed as a fraction.
Profit amount from the sale, can be positive or negative indicating gain or loss.
